intro.h2: Old tub, new finish, same bathroom
paragraphs: THE TUB GUYS handles bathtub refinishing in McKinney, TX and across the DFW area. If your tub is rusty, stained, scratched, cracked or stuck in a color from another decade, we resurface it so it comes out clean and glossy, with no tear-out and no new tub to haul in. Our before and after photos show a mint green tub turned white and tubs brought back from heavy staining.

Customers notice the small things too. One says our tech, Ivan, arrived 20 minutes early, treated the house with respect and cleaned up nicely after himself. Another has used us for more than six years. Getting started is easy: send a few pictures of your tub and we will reply with a quote.

items.name: Bathtub refinishing
items.blurb: This is the heart of our work. We take tubs that are rusty, stained, scratched or simply worn out and give them a smooth, bright new surface. The photo shows a badly stained tub in a white subway tile surround, refinished to a clean, even white.

image.alt: Before and after: a heavily stained bathtub in a white subway tile surround refinished to bright white

items.name: Color change for dated tubs
items.blurb: Living with a mint green tub from years ago? Refinishing can turn it white so it suits the bathroom you have today. Color matching also comes up in our Google reviews, so mention your tile and fixtures when you send photos and we will talk through options.

image.alt: Before and after: a mint green bathtub refinished in white, shown with The Tub Guys logo

items.name: Crack, chip and spot repair
items.blurb: Not every tub needs a full refinish. We repair cracks, chips and worn spots, like the broken edge on the paneled tub apron shown here. One customer had us refinish the bottom of a tub with significant cracking and felt the price was very reasonable.

image.alt: Before and after: a cracked chip on a white tub apron repaired to a smooth, even edge

items.name: Corner and freestanding tubs
items.blurb: Garden tubs and freestanding soaking tubs wear out as well. Our photos include a corner tub with yellowed, peeling patches restored to clean white, plus freestanding tubs where cracks and dark marks along the curved sides were repaired and blended back in.

image.alt: Before and after: a corner garden tub with yellowed, peeling patches refinished to clean white

items.name: Tile and countertop resurfacing
items.blurb: Tubs are not the only surfaces we bring back. We also resurface tile and countertops, so dated shower walls or a worn top can get a fresh finish without demolition. Shower wall reglazing is mentioned in our Google reviews. Send photos of the surface for a quote.

about.text: THE TUB GUYS is a bathtub refinishing contractor at 2631 Mountain View Dr in McKinney, TX, serving the DFW area. Resurfacing is what we do: bathtubs first, plus tile and countertops. We quote from your photos, so you can send a few pictures and know the price before anyone comes out. On the day of the job, a tech such as Ivan, who is named in one of our reviews, protects the area, repairs and refinishes the surface, and cleans up before leaving. You will spot our logo on the work truck.

service_area.h2: Bathtub refinishing in McKinney and across DFW
service_area.text: THE TUB GUYS is based at 2631 Mountain View Dr in McKinney, TX, and our own Google post says we serve the DFW area. Because we quote from photos, finding out whether your home is in range takes one message. Send pictures of your tub along with your town, and we will reply with a price and an appointment time that works.

items.q: How do I get a quote?
items.a: Send a few pictures of your tub through Facebook Messenger, or call (214) 300-8111. We look at the photos and reply with a free estimate. One customer handled the whole job through Messenger and says the price and appointment time were transparent from the start.

items.q: Is refinishing a cheaper option than replacing my tub?
items.a: Our own post describes resurfacing as an affordable alternative to replacement, without the cost and hassle of pulling out the old tub. Your tub stays where it is and gets a new surface. For an exact number, send photos and we will price your specific tub.

items.q: Can you fix a crack or chip without redoing the whole tub?
items.a: Often, yes. Our photos show chipped edges and cracked spots repaired and blended into the surrounding finish, and one customer had us refinish just the bottom of a tub that had significant cracking. Send a close-up photo of the damage so we can tell you what your tub needs.

items.q: Do you work on anything besides bathtubs?
items.a: Yes. Along with bathtub resurfacing, we offer tile and countertop resurfacing, and shower wall reglazing is mentioned in our Google reviews. We also handle corner garden tubs and freestanding soaking tubs. Send pictures of the surface you want refreshed and we will let you know.

items.q: What are your hours and where do you work?
items.a: We are open Monday through Friday from 8 AM to 5 PM and Saturday from 9 AM to 3 PM, and closed on Sunday. We are based in McKinney, TX and serve the DFW area. Call (214) 300-8111 or message us on Facebook.

final_cta.text: Snap a few photos of your tub and send them over for a free estimate.
